title: Confirm contest rules
description: Check official portal: coding window, AI disclosure, team eligibility, deadlines/time zone, source/video/track; record organizer evidence. Do not code outside allowed window.
acceptance_criteria: Rules evidence or explicit unresolved blocker; no invented requirement

title: Toolchain / mint / x402 spike
description: Install official skills/MCP; record revision; pin mutually compatible Rust, Anchor, Solana CLI and TS versions; run hello build/local validator; fund disposable Devnet wallets; verify 6-decimal legacy mint or create TEST mint; check actual x402 full-bundle compatibility for max 45 min.
acceptance_criteria: Build and local validator work; mint/funding recorded; direct Anchor fallback chosen if x402 unproven

title: Config and immutable registry
description: Implement initializer authorization, Config, DataAsset seed derivation, register and set_asset_active; validate price/hash/version/mint/authority. Generate IDL.
acceptance_criteria: Only permitted initializer/provider succeeds; terms immutable; inactive toggles work

title: Private data store and seed
description: Apply SQLite schema, normalize fixture bytes, generate deterministic fixture IDs/hashes; map real test provider wallets, precreate ATAs; implement import and metadata-only search. Register via H03 when available.
acceptance_criteria: 12 rows, correct hashes, no raw bodies in search; A01+B01 selection; missing tag yields gap

title: Atomic purchase and receipt
description: Implement purchase_unit and receipt PDA with exact signed expected terms, timestamp, checked split and ATA checks. Construct two instructions same tx, one fee payer; serialize, simulate, measure size. If necessary use tested v0 ALT; never split required demo.
acceptance_criteria: One tx for two distinct providers; exact 24k each and 12k treasury; two receipts; fits 1232 bytes

title: Adversarial purchase tests
description: Test duplicate receipt, wrong signer/mint/ATA, changed terms, inactive, insufficient funds, second instruction failure; assert first transfer and receipt rolled back; verify actual token balance deltas.
acceptance_criteria: No partial transfer or receipt, including deliberate second failure; fee exception documented

title: Quote and delivery verification API
description: Create search/quote/receipt/challenge/delivery/health routes, 120s quote, wallet proof 60s one-use nonce, finalized program/PDA verification, exact bytes, hash compare, SQL reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: Unpaid/wrong buyer/forged receipt/replay denied; fresh nonce same receipt free; timeout pending not recharged

title: Purchase demo CLI
description: Wire deterministic agent search→quote→budget→sign→finalized→deliver→source report; save tx signature and receipts; assert exact deltas and hashes.
acceptance_criteria: Real two-provider Devnet tx when deployment ready; local test first; no mock success

title: Bounty funding and submission
description: Implement Bounty PDA and vault ATA, transfer reward, deadline; submit inactive asset by owning provider; hash canonical requirement; enforce no transfer on submission.
acceptance_criteria: 2 TEST locked, no payout upon submit; wrong requester/provider/expired submission rejected

title: Bounty accept and expiry refund
description: Implement requester acceptance with selected submission + expected hashes, exact reward split and bounty receipt; expiry refund; terminal guards; tests for races/unauthorized and unsolicited vault surplus.
acceptance_criteria: 1.6 TEST provider, 0.4 treasury, receipt; independent full refund; no double payout

title: Gap-to-data agent demo
description: CLI funds bounded missing-tag bounty; provider registers solution; deterministic required-field review, requester signs acceptance, deliver via bounty receipt, provider activates; separate expired refund demo.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end gap, funding, review, acceptance, delivery, catalog activation and refund evidence

title: Minimal evidence UI
description: Catalog, receipts, bounty and evidence views; real cluster/mint status, pending/finalized, Explorer links, explicit synthetic badge. Read-only acceptable; CLI actions documented.
acceptance_criteria: No raw payload, no keys, no fake balances, accessible responsive screen

title: Devnet deployment and integrated verification
description: Run build/test, deploy once after rule clearance, initialize config, seed and run both demos, measure receipt rent, tx size/CU, actual deltas; check no secrets, persist sanitized evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Real program ID and finalized signatures, receipt hashes and balance evidence; disclose unavailable network

title: Submission and demo freeze
description: Freeze core, run smoke, record video per portal rules, update English pitch with real evidence only, package README/reproduction and limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Submission checklist complete or explicit portal blocker; no false claims

title: Optional x402 transport
description: Only if H02 full compatibility passed: use reference SDK/facilitator, verify exact complete two-receipt transaction and buyer binding; no duplicate payment path. Otherwise skip.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end verified full transaction or explicitly omitted

title: Optional product MCP / third unit
description: Expose metadata search or verified read tool with same auth; OR test third unit within size/compute budget. Do not risk core.
acceptance_criteria: Verified optional feature only; no registry claim unless published

title: Post-event online product validation
description: AI desk research and opt-in product analytics; actual paid demand after legal approval.
acceptance_criteria: Document actual evidence, not AI estimates

title: Post-event commercial and scale review
description: Re-estimate rent, fees, legal rights, refunds, security audit, commercial pricing and compressed receipts; revise archived finance model.
